confidence_notes: Restaurant meal and cappuccino anchors rest on Numbeo's Cordoba figures (May 2026 label) and travel-guide ranges, the strongest part of this estimate. Beer serving size is unconfirmed. Wine by the glass rests on one secondhand guide range (EUR 3-5), and the cocktail on a generic range; both were sanity-checked against the beer relationship. Hostel and hotel anchors are holistic model estimates for July 2026 with no accommodation searches or live listings, so treat them as roughly 25% either way. EUR prices were converted at an assumed general-knowledge rate of about 1.16 USD per EUR, not a fetched rate. The RBA rate comes from search-result text for the RBA exchange-rates page, not a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink anchors use Cordoba-specific figures (Numbeo and travel-guide ranges), not a proxy city. Accommodation anchors are general-knowledge estimates for comparable mid-sized Spanish cities in summer.
